harmfulness.reason: "Mix 1 teaspoon dish soap into 1 litre of water" and spray every leaf, stem and the soil surface. Dish detergents are not true insecticidal soaps and can cause leaf burn, especially on an already-damaged plant in 35 °C heat. There is no patch-test caveat, and spraying soap onto the soil adds little. The evening timing and "Stop using sulphur" reduce risk, and the advice is low-toxicity overall. The main concern is that soap may be too weak to clear an entrenched infestation, though weekly monitoring with traps limits the risk of delay.
